## What's new

- **Preferences** (Home → Preferences…): save automatically before opening another map (on by default); off, a map with unsaved changes asks to save or discard.
- **Esc with nothing selected** offers Save and close, Discard and close, or Cancel.
- **Double-click an object** to select every object of that kind; Delete, copy and cut act on all of them. Changing view deselects objects.
- **Layers with Shift+scroll:** choose which layer a tile goes on before painting it (the preview shows it in front of or behind), and narrow an area selection to one layer so copy, cut and delete act on just that layer.
- **Paste preview** shades the tiles a paste or preset would replace, with a count.
- **Presets:** right-click to place, rename, change category, duplicate or delete (the file is kept as a backup). The Preset builder starts with the map's tile libraries, lets you add any DT1, and copies tiles in as Act 0.
- **New map:** choose *(New Lvltype)* or *(Choose Existing)*; Add to game can give the level a level type of its own.
- **Wall hiding** (Map tab), using the same hide areas as roof hiding.
- **Automap:** draw a wall piece where a tree or roof stands in a wall's place.
- **Pasting a DT1** whose file name clashes with one the map already loads asks for a new name.

## Fixes

- **Compatibility check** renames tile paths longer than 41 characters, all together, and updates LvlTypes/LvlPrest.
- **Compatibility check** removes AutoMap rows with no picture (Cel1 -1), which crash the game while loading. An earlier "Clear piece" wrote them.
- **Asset cleanup** only changes files in your mod and save folders, and keeps its backups in the app's data folder.
